Saw something floating out there near 08-08.31N 057-01.47W — looked like a big chunk of wood or maybe part of a pallet, half-submerged and hard to spot until you're pretty close. Gave it a wide berth but another boat might not see it in time, especially at night.
Heard survey ops working near 11-16.31N 077-59.73W with vessels and gear in the area, keep a sharp lookout and give them room. Officer report, good quality.
Noticed a survey vessel working around 11-15.24N 078-03.01W with gear in the water; boats should give it some room. Recreational report, looked active at the time.

Spotted a red can buoy sitting really low in the water at 22-17.15N 097-44.34W — looks like it's taking on water or the float's compromised, barely showing above the surface at high tide. Worth giving it a wide berth until someone checks it out.

Spotted a red can buoy sitting real low in the water at 22-16.90N 097-42.99W — looks like it's taken on water or the mooring chain's dragging, because it's well off its charted position and showing a heavy list to one side. Worth giving it a wide berth until someone gets out to check it.

Spotted a red can buoy sitting pretty low in the water near 22-16.64N 097-44.47W — looks like she's taking on water or the mooring's dragging, because she was well off her charted position. Gave her a wide berth, but worth sending someone out to check before she goes under altogether.
Spotted a buoy off station around 36-44.38N 075-59.44W—looks adrift and a bit low in the water. Please use caution until it’s checked.
Noticed a buoy off station around 36-43.57N 075-59.77W while passing through today. Might be drifted or missing from its charted spot, so keep a sharp lookout.

Spotted a survey vessel working a grid pattern at 04-59.56N 047-49.00W — she's got gear in the water and is moving slow and unpredictable, so give her a wide berth. Didn't see much in the way of advance notice on this one, so watch yourselves if you're transiting that area.

Heads up — ran into a survey vessel working slow grid patterns at 04-59.71N 047-49.02W, towing what looked like some kind of cable or streamer off the stern. She wasn't making much way and had limited ability to manoeuvre, so give her a wide berth if you're passing through that area.
Spotted a derelict drifting near 37-49.93N 074-26.84W today, looked like an unlit hull awash. Keep a sharp watch in the area.
Came across what looked like a derelict hull drifting near 37-48.41N 074-29.79W. No lights or markings visible—recreational report, moderate confidence.
Spotted a derelict object adrift at 37-48.71N 074-30.11W during watch. Looks partially submerged and could be a serious hazard to navigation.

Spotted what looks like a semi-submerged container or large debris just sitting low in the water at 38-35.35N 070-27.08W — nearly missed it in the chop, so it's basically invisible until you're right on top of it. Giving it a wide berth and marking it here so nobody else gets a nasty surprise. Watch yourselves out there.

Saw something floating out here near 38-35.23N 070-27.72W that didn't look right — big dark mass, maybe a container or a heap of nets, sitting just under the surface where you'd barely catch it till you're right on top of it. Keeping well clear, but somebody ought to check it out.
Spotted a rocket/lights in the sky near 28-44.11N 080-28.65W while underway, seemed low and might indicate a launch area. Recommend giving the area a wide berth until clear.
Saw a rocket launch/impact hazard reported near 28-44.20N 080-28.48W while out on my small craft. Recommend giving the area wide berth until activity clears.

Noticed a lit buoy sitting well off its charted position at 17-28.04N 087-29.27W — looks like it's dragged its mooring, maybe 3 or 4 cables to the NE of where it should be. Giving it a wide berth and flagging it for anyone transiting the area.

Picked up a red can buoy adrift and awash near 17-27.81N 087-29.51W — looks like it's broken free from its mooring, barely showing above the surface and no light working. Watch yourself if you're transiting that area at night.

Spotted a red can buoy at 17-28.24N 087-29.51W that's clearly dragging — she's sitting way off her charted position and listing pretty bad, probably fouled ground tackle. Watch your approach if you're heading into that channel, easy to mistake her for the proper mark.

Spotted a red can buoy at 17-28.83N 087-29.90W that's clearly dragging — thing was sitting at a real odd angle and had a bunch of weed and line fouled around its chain. Gave it a wide berth, but worth checking out before someone mistakes it for a proper mark.

Spotted a red can buoy sitting pretty low in the water near 17-28.67N 087-29.64W — looks like she's taking on water or the mooring's shifted, because she's listing badly to one side and barely showing above the surface. Gave her a wide berth but worth someone checking before she goes under completely.
Spotted a derelict hull floating low in the water at 29-48.55N 071-16.29W—looked unlit and partly submerged. Marking for others to avoid; keep a sharp lookout in that area.

Spotted a beat-up wooden vessel, looks like an old longliner, drifting with no lights and no sign of anyone aboard at 29-49.43N 071-16.28W. She's sitting low on her port side and could be a real problem for traffic in the area — watch yourselves out there.
Spotted what looked like a derelict hull floating low in the water near 29-48.97N 071-17.28W while fishing. Gave it a wide berth and passing the word.

Heading back in from the grounds when we spotted what looked like an expended rocket casing — or maybe a whole dud — bobbing low in the water around 04-55.44N 052-07.96W, easy to miss in any kind of chop. Thing's half-submerged and sitting just below the surface, real nasty snag risk for nets or a prop. Giving it a wide berth and flagging it up for anyone working that area.

Spotted what looks like an unexploded rocket or flare casing — military-type, maybe 3 feet long — floating just below the surface near 04-55.83N 052-05.18W. Came across it at slow speed so no contact, but it's a real risk for anyone running at pace in these waters. Giving it a wide berth and flagging it up for others.

Spotted what looks like an unexploded rocket or missile casing half-submerged and drifting at 04-56.17N 052-05.04W — thing's maybe 2 metres long, dark grey, moving with the current. Gave it a wide berth and marking it here so others do the same. Recommend all vessels in the area keep eyes open and don't attempt recovery.

Spotted what looked like a signal rocket or flare trajectory arcing low over the water near 04-56.12N 052-06.27W — didn't see any vessel in obvious distress but the thing came down pretty fast and close to the surface. Worth keeping an eye out if you're passing through, could be someone messing around or maybe a genuine emergency that got sorted before we could raise anyone.
Spotted a buoy off station near 41-42.73N 070-30.42W, drifting a bit and not where charts show. Please use caution if transiting the area.
Spotted a buoy sitting off its charted spot near 41-43.34N 070-28.39W—looks to be drifting. Worth keeping an eye out if you’re transiting the area.

Spotted rocket in water, drifting, possible ordnance hazard near 38-00.40N 099-23.19W. Kept clear.
Observed a rocket launch splashdown debris drifting across traffic lane near 25-36.85N 080-21.87W at 1430 UTC; recommend caution, fragments and fumes reported from range today.
Wreck showing just below surface at 38-11.32N 092-51.66W, snagged our lead. Keep clear, not well marked.
Noticed general hazard in the lane near 25-09.88N 097-08.77W—floating debris and small craft cutting across traffic. Recommend extra lookout and reduced speed.
Rocket debris sighted drifting near 40-07.16N 099-41.02W, low in water, keep clear.

Observed unlit floating debris in main shipping lane at 48-10.51N 052-44.29W during night transit, roughly the size of a small container, drifting south with current. Traffic heavy and visibility; recommend caution and reduced speed in area until cleared. No marks or lights seen on object; hard to spot.
Derelict hull sighted at 40-03.62N 093-39.03W drifting NE, low in water. No AIS, unlit.

Spotted a derelict 8-10m fishing skiff, grey hull low in the water, no lights or markings, drifting across the eastbound lane at 05-04.36N 052-02.56W around 0145 UTC. No crew seen and current is setting it toward the TSS, so keep a sharp lookout and give wide berth; we slowed and altered 10 degrees to pass clear, radar return weak with some debris alongside on starboard side here.
Noticed a hazard floating near 41-46.06N 093-24.15W, keep a sharp lookout.

Noted an unlit wreck awash at 16-10.55N 061-35.02W in the main outbound lane, only a rusted frame showing with breaking seas over it. Passed close on reduced speed and saw no buoying or AIS target; recommend wide berth and warn traffic, especially at night or in low vis.
Wreck just awash near 39-32.43N 094-15.57W. No lit marker seen.

Spotted what looked like a spent rocket stage floating low in the shipping lane near 23-30.76N 097-28.96W; metallic cylinder with scorch marks and some debris around it. We altered slightly to pass clear—advise caution if transiting, it’s just off the main track.
Possible hazard noted near 35-50.31N 093-23.59W, uncharted obstruction or debris, kept clear. Crew advised caution passing through.

Observed a rocket launch from shore off the shipping lane near 41-44.00N 070-30.50W; bright plume and debris trail overhead, with some fragments apparently falling seaward. Advised nearby traffic to keep clear and maintain lookout for falling objects and possible splashdown area.
Derelict hull low in water near 43-06.81N 096-56.04W, drifting slow, no lights.

Spotted a derelict wooden fishing skiff adrift in the shipping lane near 11-46.62N 047-34.74W, low in the water with no lights or markings, bow partially submerged. Moderate swell, little freeboard—hard to see on radar. Recommend caution and reduce speed in area.
Rocket seen low over water near 41-49.84N 092-03.85W, drifting east, no comms.

On passage in the shipping lane near 12-26.92N 071-13.89W, we observed a small rocket launch or flare rising fast from a low craft and breaking up overhead, with debris falling close astern. No distress signals on VHF, but traffic nearby was startled; recommend caution and report to authorities if further launches seen again.
Wreck sighted at 34-41.17N 099-31.89W, just awash, no marks. Keep clear.
Noticed unlit wreck showing only a small structure awash near 22-16.25N 091-21.90W right in the shipping lane at low tide; gives no AIS target, keep clear and report wide berth.
Wreck reported at 35-14.32N 096-02.89W, just awash, small debris around. No buoying seen.
Sighted derelict fishing vessel low in the water at 33-26.67N 079-13.04W, mid-lane. Unlit, drifting east with tide, posing collision risk to traffic. No crew visible, no AIS, reported to VTS.
Saw hazard near 42-59.54N 094-32.32W, unlit object adrift, hard to spot. Keep sharp lookout.

Observed active rocket launch corridor marked by debris and smoke while transiting shipping lane at 22-17.21N 091-27.59W; traffic slowed and several vessels altered course. No official warning received on VHF, but we heard rumble and saw burning fragments falling seaward, risk of impact to decks and gear; recommend caution and reroute until clear.
Derelict small yacht, low in water, drifting NE at 43-56.78N 092-31.70W. No lights seen.

Observed an active rocket launch hazard in the lane near 46-15.63N 064-00.36W; saw bright booster ascent from coastal range with falling fragments and no warning on VHF. Traffic density high, recommend avoiding area 5 nm radius for next hour as splashdown debris could impact vessels; several ships altered course, lights and radar returns intermittently obscured by smoke, sky extremely bright, loud roar heard.
Rocket spotted at 42-26.36N 099-10.78W, low and fast, heading seaward. Keep clear.

Spotted a low-in-water derelict wooden skiff drifting in the eastbound shipping lane near 08-07.02N 056-58.60W; no lights or markings. Looks recently abandoned, taking on water, rolling heavily—recommend caution and wide berth.
Derelict hull drifting near 40-05.77N 097-02.20W. Low in water, hard to see.

Observed an unlit rocket or missile casing drifting in the westbound lane near 32-32.57N 053-08.95W, about 20 nm off the separation scheme. Orange paint, about 3 meters long, low in the water, with occasional bubbles; no navigation lights or markings seen and it was slowly rotating, passing traffic had to alter to avoid.
Derelict boat adrift near 33-28.41N 095-48.30W, low in water, no lights. Hard to spot at dusk.

Passed a partially submerged wreck right in the shipping lane at 28-34.41N 080-31.13W; only the bow and a few timbers showing, no buoyage or lights. It’s a real hazard to traffic here, especially at night or in low visibility.
Uncharted hazard sighted near 40-35.34N 096-05.02W. Keeping clear.

Spotted a derelict wooden fishing skiff, low in the water and unlit, drifting in the northbound shipping lane at 28-36.62N 079-52.33W around 0430Z; no crew or markings seen.
